name: Pullout lot on the north side of Angeles Crest Hwy above Williamson Rock
basis: Guidebook-style Getting There text (SummitPost/MP excerpts via search): two lots east of the rock on the same side of Angeles Crest Highway, the first marked with a steep climbers' trail descending into the canyon, the second a couple hundred yards further. The westernmost/closest mapped unnamed lot (700 m from the crag) was taken as the first lot; the road-check tool could not run (Overpass unreachable) so match is by position only. Eagles Roost lot (permit, 1 km south) not used for the rock itself; sub-areas already having parking untouched. Note: rock has seasonal closures for frog habitat.
